title: Northbeam TechWorks Settlement of the Invoice Standing on a Job
content:
A business holding a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job may ask to settle the invoice standing on that job. The request is answered by taking a payment against the job for the figure the settlement comes to.

The figure the invoice settles is worked out only after the relief the business contract owes stands recorded against the job's charges. Until that relief stands recorded against the job's charges, the figure the invoice settles is not worked out.

## What the payment does to the job

The payment stands on the job as its own entry and lowers the service charges outstanding on it by the amount received, so the invoice on that job is cleared down to what is left. A business profile settles the figure within the service's payment terms.

## Taking the payment

The payment is taken with `settle_deployment_invoice_642fded5`. It is a tool of the customer's own: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the person acting for the business profile — runs it to settle the invoiced charges. It is not listed among the ordinary desk tools and is reached only once unlocked.

One call books one payment entry on that job for the amount the business pays and lowers the job's outstanding service charges by it. The entry is dated the day the money is taken and is taken as a business desk entry.

## The four values the call carries

- `service_agreement_id` — an identifier: the reference number of the TechWorks work order or care agreement whose invoiced charges are being settled, as the agent hands it over before the call.
- `customer_id` — an identifier: the reference number of the paying business profile, as the agent hands it over before the call.
- `payment_amount` — the amount being paid, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed, always positive.
- `payment_method` — how the money is being sent, exactly one of the five values below.

| `payment_method` | When it is the way recorded |
| --- | --- |
| `card_on_file` | the card kept on the profile is charged |
| `store_credit` | a store credit balance is spent instead of money |
| `bank_transfer` | the business sends the money from its bank account |
| `in_store_cash` | someone pays cash at a store counter |
| `business_invoice` | the amount is left on the business account's invoice to be settled on its terms |

## What the call returns

A one-line confirmation string naming the payment entry reference that was created, the job it was booked on, the amount received in USD to two decimal places, the way it was sent and the job's new outstanding service charges in USD to two decimal places. The presence of that entry reference in the reply is what shows the payment was recorded.

On success the job carries one more entry and a lower outstanding figure, and the business has a payment reference to put against its own invoice.
